title: RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE calibration sweep — dense, top-5, Gold Set v1
method: arc eval --mode dense --topk 5 --min-score <s> for each sweep point; full Gold Set v1 (51 queries, 43 relevance + 8 abstention)

selected_operating_point.rationale: Highest threshold with recall@5 flat vs baseline (0.7403, within the 5% regression budget) while raising no_evidence_precision 0.0 -> 0.375. At 0.7 abstention reaches 1.0 but recall regresses 21% beyond the allowed budget.
selected_operating_point.conclusion: A single global cosine threshold cannot simultaneously maximize recall and abstention precision on a semantically coherent corpus. High-precision abstention is deferred to M4 where richer relevance signals (hybrid retrieval, sparse evidence, reranking, semantic relevance gating) become available.
